objective_for_doctor:
Age: 17
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: loss of consciousness

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’m here because I lost consciousness. I’ve also been coughing up blood, having significant shortness of breath, and I have sharp pain (intensity 4/10) on my chest sides and posterior chest wall, going to my scapulae and back areas.

Did you completely pass out, and if so about how long were you unconscious? Also, did you have any warning signs beforehand like dizziness, palpitations, chest pressure, or worsening shortness of breath?

Have you had any fever or chills?
When did these symptoms start, and which came first: the coughing up blood, the shortness of breath, the chest/back pain, or the loss of consciousness?
Have you had any recent leg swelling or calf pain, recent long travel or immobility, surgery, cancer, pregnancy, or are you taking estrogen-containing medications?

Yes. I’ve had deep vein thrombosis (DVT), I’ve had swelling in one or more areas (posterior aspect of the ankle on the right), I’ve been unable to move or get up for more than 3 consecutive days within the last 4 weeks, I’ve had surgery within the last month, I have an active cancer, and I have traveled out of the country to North America in the last 4 weeks. I currently take hormones.
Have you had any recent trauma, and is the blood you’re coughing up definitely from the lungs rather than vomiting blood? Also, is the chest pain worse with breathing?
